status.text: Scion's last 13F covers Q3 2025 and was filed on 3 November 2025: $1.4bn in eight lines, most of it put options. Neither Scion nor the two managers its reports included, Scion Asset Partners and Scion Capital Group, has filed a 13F or a 13F notice for any quarter since, and no other filer reports its holdings.

Tybourne's 13F book fell from $398m at the end of 2024 to between $24m and $35m in each quarter of 2025, under the $100m level at which a manager must file. Its report for Q3 2025 was the last it owed: it filed a final Form N-PX for the period to 30 September 2025 in February 2026 and no 13F for any quarter since.
